notes: Batch 050 ISB records were rechecked against the official /admissions/pgplp/ page: it explicitly names the Post Graduate Programme in Management (PGP), gives a 12-month duration, lists Hyderabad and Mohali, and describes the Class of 2027 admissions process. The source and programme match; the 6 Dec 2026 Round 2 deadline is time-sensitive and is not represented as historical as of 22 Nov 2026.

Batch 050 St John's College Agra page title still says 2025-26 while the body welcomes 2026-27 applicants. The admissions card retains the warning; the B.A. course listing has no explicit academic year. No deadline is promoted as current.

The Sonipat catalogue identity's short name JGU and official O.P. Jindal Global University campus/address match; this is distinct from the similarly named O.P. Jindal University in Raigarh. The source does not support transferring Raigarh facts to this catalogue row.

All 8 new candidates were directly checked against their official page excerpts. Undated programme/contact/facility facts carry no invented academic year and explicitly direct students to recheck current availability. RGU's source lists semester duration, retained as semesters without conversion to months.

Sixteen prior basic profiles remain held for source access, authority, freshness or identity reasons; the per-institution reasons above are carried forward, not presented as fresh retrievals unless explicitly noted. No persistent owner-review database was accessed or changed.
